engineering.label: Engineering (Civil / Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics)
engineering.note: Shared track — these disciplines overlap enough in slide shape to use one layout set rather than four.
engineering.notes: Schematics, CAD drawings, spec/tolerance tables must be source-accurate.

computer_science.label: Computer Science
computer_science.notes: Architecture/flow diagrams can be generated if clearly labeled; algorithm code must be exact, never paraphrased.

medicine.label: Medicine
medicine.notes: Anatomical and clinical images must be source-accurate — never generate anatomical diagrams from scratch.

arts.label: Arts
arts.notes: Image-critique-heavy: large image + annotation layout is the dominant pattern, not diagram/data density.

other.label: Other / Unclassified Higher Ed
other.notes: Fallback to core archetypes + higher_ed style tokens until volume justifies a dedicated track.
